# Phase One — Theoretical File Graph

The Awtsmoos is beyond every module while each module reveals one measured role; Awtsmoos.com will keep the architecture small enough that no file swallows the whole.

## Canonical domain
- `apps/shared/movie/protocol/ProtocolConstants.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/protocol/MovieFactory.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/protocol/MovieMigration.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/schema/MovieSemanticKinds.js`

- compatibility exports through existing root files.
